# All4Ruse

> All4Ruse is a Bulgarian events platform for the city of Ruse. It lists concerts, exhibitions, theatre, sports, workshops, and all public events happening in Ruse, Bulgaria.

## What it does

All4Ruse aggregates and publishes upcoming, live, and past public events in the city of Ruse (Русе), Bulgaria. Anyone can browse events for free; registered users can save events, create new events, and manage their public host profile.

## Key pages

- Homepage (upcoming events): https://all4ruse.com/bg
- Past events: https://all4ruse.com/bg/past
- Current / live events: https://all4ruse.com/bg/current
- Why All4Ruse: https://all4ruse.com/bg/why-all4ruse
- Advertise: https://all4ruse.com/bg/advertise

## Languages

Content is available in four languages, each at its own locale prefix:

- Bulgarian (bg): https://all4ruse.com/bg — primary language
- English (en): https://all4ruse.com/en
- Ukrainian (uk): https://all4ruse.com/ua
- Romanian (ro): https://all4ruse.com/ro

## Event pages

Each event has a dedicated page at `https://all4ruse.com/bg/[slug]` with full details: title, date, time, location, price, description, and organisers. Events include structured JSON-LD (schema.org/Event) for machine readability.

## Notes

- Event data is real and updated regularly by the All4Ruse team and community.
- The platform focuses exclusively on Ruse, Bulgaria — not a national or global aggregator.
- Sitemap: https://all4ruse.com/sitemap.xml

## Full event listing

A full listing of all live event URLs is available at: https://all4ruse.com/sitemap.xml
